fusions.name: Prey to Prey
fusions.desc: You bite every enemy within 2.5 tiles for 4 damage. The bite then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that damage each, and you heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Weakest Link
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Casts a hooked line at an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 22 damage, leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Shackled Together
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: One After Another
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, lightning leaps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 8 lightning damage, then to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that damage each. Once every 6 seconds.
